title: Students from Lakeside or Hillview
statementMd:
List students living in Lakeside or Hillview with their city.

Expected columns: `name`, `city`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, city FROM students WHERE city IN ('Lakeside', 'Hillview');
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
